{{Quote|It's a venrap. If its poison doesn't kill you, it'll just crush you to death.|Klay Firewell to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>}}
A '''venrap''' was a large [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Snake/Legends|snake]] native to the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]]. Its venom was [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]], and the powerful creature could crush to death a much larger being.

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was protected from a venrap by [[Klay Firewell]], a boy from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. Later, a venrap slithered aboard a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] on Nallastia and, upon liftoff from the [[Skull Queen's fortress]], attacked [[Nico Medina|its captain]] and two [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilots]]. The pilots were rendered unconscious, but unharmed, before [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and the [[Skull Queen]], [[Quenelle]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] the vicious creature. The Skull Queen dealt the snake the killing blow with her [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], striking it between the eyes.
